name: Song Chuan Precision Co., Ltd.
summary: Song Chuan Precision Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells electromechanical power relays in Taiwan and internationally. It primarily offers relays, PCB and plug-in automotive relays, PCB miniature power relays, industrial and general-purpose relays, and safety relays for home appliance, automotive, IT product, and other applications. The company was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
